description.value: Choices Market is a 100% BC-owned natural and organic grocery chain operating since 1990, with this South Surrey location stocking an extensive selection of local, organic, and specialty food items. The store offers free in-store Nutrition Tours led by Registered Dietitians and Holistic Nutritionists, making it a distinctive stop beyond a typical grocery run. As part of Western Canada's largest natural and organic grocer, it prioritizes Canadian and locally sourced products across all departments.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this is the South Surrey location of Choices Market at 3248 King George Blvd, V4P 1A5, with phone (604) 541 3902 matching OSM tags exactly. The site establishes it as a full-service natural and organic supermarket with specialty and local food items, confirming basic groceries. No website or OSM evidence addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Tsawwassen' but the website's own Contact Us page identifies this location as 'South Surrey' (3248 King George Blvd, Surrey, B.C. V4P 1A5). The address and postal code are consistent; the community label may be geographically inaccurate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established full-service natural and organic supermarket confirmed open at the listed address; a valuable resupply point for touring cyclists in the South Surrey/Tsawwassen area.
